title: Verify the Estimate column shows Tech Time and labor rates are hidden for Technician
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Technician role. (this role uses Tech View).
At least one work order exists that contains labor and part lines with prices entered.
steps:
1. Open a work order and open a line.
2. Look at the Estimate column.
3. Look for labor rate columns and fields.
expected:
Step 1: The line opens in Tech View.
Step 2: The Estimate column shows Tech Time, NOT the estimate money value.
Step 3: Labor rate columns/fields are hidden.
